sourceFacts.fact: Congenital rubella syndrome can cause cataracts, hearing loss and congenital heart defects.
These are classic associations, not an exhaustive list or a requirement that all occur together.

layoutSpecification: Title 'Congenital rubella'. Build a large balanced triangular association map: a small central ochre circle with a generic dotted virus SYMBOL, not microbiology detail, branches with three equal arrows to three widely spaced large mnemonic icons. TOP vertex: a cloudy rectangular window pane labelled 'Cataracts'. LOWER LEFT vertex: a bell with fading sound-wave marks labelled 'Hearing loss'. LOWER RIGHT vertex: a flat Valentine-heart symbol with a small warning dot beside it, label 'Heart defects'. No anatomical eye, lens cross-section, ear, cardiac chambers or vessel connections. Each icon is a metaphor. At bottom 'Classic associations • not all are present'. Do not suggest the triangle diagnoses rubella by itself.
